import pathlib, re
p = pathlib.Path('/Users/guillaumeloulier/PhpstormProjects/oss/elephc/.claude/worktrees/streams-csv-signature/src/gz_prelude.rs')
t = p.read_text()
for name in ('gzclose', 'gzeof', 'gzgetc', 'gzgets', 'gzread', 'gzwrite', 'gzputs',
             'gzpassthru', 'gzrewind', 'gzseek', 'gztell'):
    old = f'function {name}($stream'
    assert t.count(old) == 1, name
    t = t.replace(old, f'function {name}(mixed $stream')
# Only the DECLARATIONS carry a type; a body's `($stream` is an argument, not a parameter.
assert not re.search(r'^function \w+\(\$stream', t, re.M), 'an untyped stream parameter remains'
old = '''//! - `?int $length = null` IS BRANCHED ON, not forwarded.'''
new = '''//! - `$stream` IS DECLARED `mixed`, and has to be. An UNTYPED parameter infers as `int` here, and
//!   the stream builtins refuse that with "expects resource, got int" — raised in the bodies of
//!   the functions the program never calls, which are checked all the same. `mixed` is what
//!   `ensure_stream_resource` accepts for a value it cannot narrow, and is what the directory
//!   prelude already passes to `readdir()` for the same reason.
//! - `?int $length = null` IS BRANCHED ON, not forwarded.'''
assert t.count(old) == 1
p.write_text(t.replace(old, new))
print('gz_prelude.rs: stream parameters declared mixed')
